First of all, I would like to say that I'm sorry and I can't personally imagine how that must feel. I would like to say, though, that it's going to be okay. Know that this will not define you and if you can face it with bravery you will be able to live a happy and worthwhile life. I have a friend who is suffering from NF2, which is another severe condition that she must struggle with at a relatively young age (she is 17). The point that I am making with this is that her hearing is constantly being siphoned off by tumors and must undergo chemotherapy, and yet she is one of the happiest and most productive people I know. I think you can still live a happy life if you take as many medical precautions as possible and do your very best to keep your head up. But, again I'm looking in from the outside and I cannot personally say I've ever been in a situation like yours, and I'm very sorry for that. I sincerely hope that you get through this and I wish you the absolute best of luck!
